side.label: Photo side
side.note: Which side the photograph sits on when there is room for two columns. On a phone it comes first, above the headline.

end.label: Photo on the right
end.note: The headline first, then the photograph. The default: the visitor reads the offer before the picture.

start.label: Photo on the left
start.note: The photograph first, then the headline. Use it when the person in the photograph faces into the page from the left, or to swap sides with a section below that also has a photograph on the right.
